description:
The Application Support Engineer role:

AlphaSights employees rely on our internal tools and client-facing platforms every day, and when something breaks they need it fixed quickly. As an Application Support Engineer, you’ll be the person they turn to. You’ll take tickets from first report to resolution, work out what actually went wrong, and partner with Software Engineers and Product Managers so the same problems stop coming back.

You’ll sit in our Technology team and work with Engineering and Product every day. Each Application Support Engineer owns a product area, and you’ll become the go-to expert on yours. That means writing its documentation, briefing the rest of the team on launches and known issues, and telling Engineering and Product where users are getting stuck.

This role suits someone who enjoys untangling messy problems, writes clearly, and prefers to act rather than wait. You’ll manage your own workload and priorities from the start.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Ticket management: Handle support requests from AlphaSights employees about our internal and client-facing platforms, from intake through resolution.

  • Troubleshooting: Find the root cause of each issue and fix what you can yourself. When a bug needs a code change, give Engineering and Product a clear write-up and follow it through to release.

  • Documentation: Write and maintain guides on how the features in your product area work, so the wider team can resolve issues without escalating.

  • Team enablement: Keep the Application Support team up to date on new launches and known issues in your area.

  • Trend reporting: Track tickets for your product area and share the patterns with Engineering and Product regularly. This helps decide which features to improve and where users need more training.

What we’re looking for:

  • 1+ years in a software-focused support role, such as Support Engineer, Customer Support Engineer or Application Support Analyst

  • Comfort with technical concepts, and a willingness to dig into logs, data and workflows to understand how a system is behaving

  • Persistence in finding the actual cause of a problem, not just a workaround

  • Good judgment on priorities when you have several open issues, based on business impact

  • Patience and empathy with colleagues who are under pressure

  • Clear, concise writing that leaves little room for misunderstanding

This position is remote-friendly. You can choose to work:

  • In-office: New York, NY

  • Remote: if you have, or will have, a permanent address in NY, NJ, PA, CT, NC, GA, or FL 

 

Compensation and Benefits:

  • $80,000 fixed base salary
  • 17 vacation days, in addition to 10 public holidays, and an end of year break between Christmas Day and New Year’s Day
  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) match – 4% of your total compensation matched dollar-for-dollar
